name: Strike and Replace
description: "Manual reporting." is struck through by a drawn red line and steps back; "Automated insights." rises in below in green.
move: "Manual reporting." is struck through by a drawn red line and steps back; "Automated insights." rises in below in green.
how: The strike is an absolutely positioned bar at 54% of the line, scaleX 0→1 from the left over 0.65s with cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1). The old line then dims to 35% and scales to 0.94 while the new words blur-rise with stagger 0.09.
adapt: Swap the old and new phrases; colours are --strike and --accent. Placeholder copy is generic; replace it with the product's words. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: All motion is inline in index.html. GSAP pages: register the CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot element and rebuild the same timeline; the split helper is inline and dependency-free.
caveats: Original implementation of the After Effects "Strikethrough reveal" idea; no AE preset files, expressions or numbers are copied and fidelity to a specific AE render is not claimed.
Starts and ends on an empty stage so it loops cleanly; trim the exit when the next shot cuts in.
